scope: Validation-only plan-once ablation; percheckpoint24trialgrid; sameenergygate as original; no protectedtest access
success_gate: Candidate unconditional schema-safe full-goal success count over all six declared scenes must be at least the zero-weight baseline count; missing, invalid and failed trials never disappear from denominators
paired_eligibility: Both runs must be checksum-verified, successfully completed processes that reached the supplied full goal with schema_safe_goal_reached=true. Timeout, abstention, collision, rollover and blockage trials cannot enter time/work tradeoff fractions
aggregation: Unweighted arithmetic mean of per-scene fractions across eligible paired safe goals; each scene has equal weight
qualification: At least three of six eligible safe pairs, mean work saving >= 0.05, mean time increase <= 0.25, and no unconditional safe-success count drop
tie_break: Choose the smallest qualifying weight in [0.02, 0.2, 0.5]
complete_valid_grid_without_qualifier: Retain declared default weight 0.02 with gate_passed=false; no optimum or energy-efficiency improvement claim
incomplete_or_invalid_grid: Block selection and freeze; selected_weight=null until the declared grid is complete and valid. Do not silently choose the default
matched_conditions: Same scene, observation, model checkpoint, native controller, source/runtime, horizon, seed and MPPI settings across compared weights. Only the energy coefficient differs
reporting: Unconditional success and all individual trials first; paired-safe tradeoffs second. One or two safe pairs are descriptive case evidence only
